title: Migration CLI: not working with Deno
body:
### Describe the bug

Hello, I am using Deno with Mikro-ORM. For so far, it works fine!
However, I would love to see the CLI/migrations working too.
I am getting the following error:

```
Error: @mikro-orm/cli needs to be installed as a local dependency!
    at CLIHelper.getConfiguration (file:///home/user/dev/Prive/Experiments/fresh-wck/node_modules/.deno/@mikro-orm+cli@7.1.0/node_modules/@mikro-orm/cli/CLIHelper.js:23:19)
    at async CLIHelper.getORM (file:///home/user/dev/Prive/Experiments/fresh-wck/node_modules/.deno/@mikro-orm+cli@7.1.0/node_modules/@mikro-orm/cli/CLIHelper.js:105:25)
    at async MigrationCommandFactory.handleMigrationCommand (file:///home/user/dev/Prive/Experiments/fresh-wck/node_modules/.deno/@mikro-orm+cli@7.1.0/node_modules/@mikro-orm/cli/commands/MigrationCommandFactory.js:103:21)
```

### Reproduction

https://github.com/maurictg/mikro-orm-deno-cli

Not really a "minimal" reproduction, but its all boilerplate code.

### What driver are you using?

None

### MikroORM version

7.1.0

### Node.js version

Deno, not node
```
deno 2.7.14 (stable, release, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)
v8 14.7.173.20-rusty
typescript 5.9.2
```

### Operating system

Linux (Fedora, in Docker dev container)
